create_initializer_zeros: create a Zeros initializer that generates tensors filled with zeros
create_initializer_ones: create an Ones initializer that generates tensors filled with ones
create_initializer_constant: create a Constant initializer that generates tensors filled with a specified scalar value
create_initializer_random_normal: create a RandomNormal initializer that generates tensors from a normal distribution with configurable mean and standard deviation
create_initializer_truncated_normal: create a TruncatedNormal initializer that generates tensors discarding values beyond two standard deviations from the mean
create_initializer_random_uniform: create a RandomUniform initializer that generates tensors from a uniform distribution within a specified range
create_initializer_identity: create an Identity initializer that generates identity matrices with an optional gain factor
create_initializer_orthogonal: create an Orthogonal initializer that generates orthogonal matrices via QR decomposition
create_initializer_variance_scaling: create a VarianceScaling initializer that adapts weight scale based on fan_in, fan_out, or fan_avg modes
test_check_initializers: test the check_initializers function that validates a dictionary of initializers against expected keys
